हैहयः^1 m. pl. N. of a people and their country.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20260502. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/commit/8ab1240.
N. of the great-grandson of Yadu.

N. of Arjuna Kārtavīrya (who had a thousand arms and was slain by
 Paraśurāma q. v.); धेनुवत्सहरणाच्च हैहयस्त्वं च कीर्तिमपहर्तुमुद्यतः
